resources.string: Check a file against Android\'s media index and your library settings.
PiPlayer couldn\'t open the selected file.
The file opens. PiPlayer needs its existing audio permission to check the music library.
The file opens. PiPlayer can\'t match it to the Android audio index. For a local file, try picking it from device or SD card storage.
The file opens. Android has no matching audio entry. If you just copied it, wait for Android to index it and then refresh the PiPlayer library.
Android has an audio entry for this file. Refresh the PiPlayer library and check again.
The track is indexed and passes your library visibility settings. Search for it in the library.
Your library settings hide this track.
Its folder is excluded in Library folders.
Android marks it as a ringtone, notification sound or alarm. Show system sounds is off.
The library treats it as a recording. Show recordings is off.
Its library duration is %1$s s. Your minimum is %2$d s.
